title: Receipt-backed publication and reference commit
description:
Consume the guarded selected context and commit publications plus exact issue-reference changes without removing any source. For fresh work, capture initial SHA-256 plus byte-size identities; derive exact owner-private destination-adjacent staging and source-adjacent quarantine/deletion-intent mappings; and append `ArchiveStarted` durably before mutation with recovery target, recorded root, operation/instance/execution IDs, fingerprint, exact initial contract, identities, staging mappings, and deletion intents. Stage and verify every artifact, validate every supported local edge in the proposed layout, publish atomically no-replace, revalidate preexisting-identical destinations before selected relinks, apply exactly planned `reference_changes`, refresh or invalidate cached asset metadata, and never rewrite pinned references. Document execution requires every direct and embedded-closure owner terminal; managed zero-owner documents may execute with informational evidence. After storage reports successful no-replace publication and relinks persist, append a normal non-reconciliation `ArchiveExecuted` recording the identity triple, exact `completed_publications`, completed relinks, and receipt-backed pending deletions. That append is the sole publication proof; append failure leaves publication unproven, source retained, and source quarantine forbidden. Reconciliation cannot add completed publications or synthesize provenance.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Before metadata commit, every staged supported local edge is validated against the proposed destination layout rather than source-resolved paths.
- [hard] REQ-02: Document execution is refused if any owner of the explicit document or any artifact in its supported bundle closure is non-terminal; a managed zero-owner document remains executable with informational evidence.
- [hard] REQ-03: Execution applies exactly planned `reference_changes`: pinned references are untouched; container execution relinks only unpinned terminal-inside references; document execution relinks every unpinned direct owner after the all-terminal check; every nonselected reference remains source-resolvable.
- [hard] REQ-04: `ArchiveStarted` appends before mutation and records recovery target, recorded destination root, operation/instance/execution IDs, fingerprint, exact initial or remaining contract, initial identities, publication staging mappings, and deletion intents; initial staging must match its identity.
- [hard] REQ-05: A normal `ArchiveExecuted` appends only after successful no-replace publications and exact relinks, records exact completed publications/relinks and pending deletions, remains durable if all later removals fail, and is the only event that can establish `published-by-instance`; no source quarantine begins before append success.
- [hard] REQ-06: Preexisting-identical or unreceipted matching destinations always retain source and are identity-revalidated before any selected relink; publication/relink append failures leave a recoverable operation with no deletion authority.
